		transactionInfo['assetId'] = assetInfo.get('assetId')
		transactionInfo['assetPath'] = assetInfo.get('assetPath')

	return transactionInfo

config.script:
transactionInfo = dict(self.view.custom.transactionInfo)

	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	transactionInfo['partId'] = transactionInfo.get('partId')
	transactionInfo['inventoryAssetId'] = transactionInfo.get('inventoryAssetId')
	
	inventoryTransactionId, msg = 	system.kanoa.inventory.issuePartToWorkOrderEvent(transactionInfo, userId)
	
	if msg:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': "Couldn't save transaction. %s" % msg})
	else:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Transaction saved successfully'})
		system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshTransactions', {})
		system.perspective.closePopup('')
	
	return

messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print("inventoryAssetSelected message received with payload " + str(payload))
	
	if len(payload['selection']) == 0: 
		inventoryAssetId = None
		assetPath        = ''
		assetName        = ''
	else:
		selection        = payload['selection'][0]['value']
		inventoryAssetId = selection['assetId']
		assetPath        = selection['assetPath']
		assetName        = selection['assetName']
	
	self.view.custom.transactionInfo.inventoryAssetId = inventoryAssetId
	self.view.custom.transactionInfo.inventoryAssetPath = assetPath  # keep for display
	self.view.custom.transactionInfo.inventoryAssetName = assetName  # keep for display
	
	return

system.perspective.print("partSelected message received with payload " + str(payload))
	
	if len(payload['selection']) == 0:
		partId = None
		partNumber = None
		partPath = None
		defaultUomId = None
	else:
		selection = payload['selection'][0]['value']
		partNumber = selection['partNumber']
		partPath = selection['partPath']
		partId = selection['partId']
		defaultUomId = selection['defaultUomId']
	
	self.view.custom.transactionInfo.partNumber = partNumber
	self.view.custom.transactionInfo.partPath = partPath
	self.view.custom.transactionInfo.partId = partId
	self.view.custom.transactionInfo.defaultUomId = defaultUomId
	
	return

system.perspective.print("inventoryPartSelected message received with payload " + str(payload))
	
	if len(payload['selection']) == 0:
		partId = None
		partNumber = None
		partPath = None
		defaultUomId = None
		inventoryAssetId = None
		inventoryAssetName = None
	else:
		selection = payload['selection'][0]['value']
		partNumber = selection['partNumber']
		partPath = selection['partPath']
		partId = selection['partId']
		defaultUomId = selection['defaultUomId']
		inventoryAssetId = selection['inventoryAssetId']
		inventoryAssetPath = selection['inventoryAssetPath']
		inventoryAssetName = selection['inventoryAssetName']
		
	self.view.custom.transactionInfo.partNumber = partNumber
	self.view.custom.transactionInfo.partPath = partPath
	self.view.custom.transactionInfo.partId = partId
	self.view.custom.transactionInfo.defaultUomId = defaultUomId
	self.view.custom.transactionInfo.inventoryAssetId = inventoryAssetId
	self.view.custom.transactionInfo.inventoryAssetPath = inventoryAssetPath
	self.view.custom.transactionInfo.inventoryAssetName = inventoryAssetName
	
	return
